title: Jamie Joyce
intro:
Jamie Joyce (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent California's 12th Congressional District. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Joyce completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
